notes: A smoke entry is accepted only after fresh exact-route identity, privacy, reasoning-disabled behavior, JSON validity, request-cap behavior, complete usage telemetry, authoritative cost, and scaffold/contract fingerprints are validated.
No v4 smoke or panel artifact carries forward. A failed or incomplete cell is retained as exclusion evidence and does not authorize the next paid cell.
The manifest cannot be marked accepted_for_panel until all eight registered models have independently accepted entries and the hidden-seed owner attestation is recorded.
